meta.description:
From the latest celebrity headlines to favorite
hilariously mundane happenings, BuzzFeed is here to
keep you updated on what all your favorite celebs
are up to.

Shows: Awkwafina, Bretman Rock & Sydney Sweeney Answer Fan Questions, Sarah Paulson & Sydney Sweeney Play With Puppies, Kevin Hart, Chris Pratt & Kevin Bacon Take Quizzes, Austin Butler, Nelly Furtado & Gracie Abrams Answer Fan Questions, BTS & WayV Play With Puppies
